sources_considered.why: Shows Anthropic changed limits to match demand to capacity. Context only, since the claim is hedged and uptime is carved out.
Secondary blog on later limit changes; not needed because the claim is not scored.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic on Wednesday adjusted its opaque usage limits for Claude customers by reducing the power of the services it delivers during times of peak demand, in an effort to balance demand with its capacity to deliver service.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic tightened peak-hour limits to match demand to capacity. This is the kind of evidence a firm claim would turn on, but the claim is hedged and exempts Claude's service problems.

unresolved_gaps: The claim is hedged and sets no measure, so no evidence can settle it without the evaluator supplying a test.
